subject: Urgent: security assessment package required for renewal — MAP gating
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearwater.co>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-01T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal gating: security assessment package request

Hi Jonas,

As part of our upcoming contract renewal and MAP gating we need the full security assessment package for Redwood Inference — specifically any penetration test / red team reports, SOC 2 attestations, and a remediation tracker or summary showing open/closed findings. Our procurement deadline to have evidence uploaded is Oct 15, 2027.

Could you confirm whether you can provide a redacted assessment suitable for external sharing and an ETA? If possible please include any attachments or a link to the documents and a point of contact for follow-up security questions.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Procurement & Vendor Risk
Clearwater Health
procurement@clearwater.co

[Attachment referenced: MAP_Renewal_Checklist.xlsx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearwater.co>, procurement@clearwater.co
Date: 2027-10-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal gating: security assessment package request

Hi Laura / Monica — looping you in so we can accelerate. Clearwater is gating the renewal on evidence (MAP-0048721) with an Oct 15 deadline. They specifically asked for penetration/red-team reports (redacted), SOC 2, and a remediation tracker.

Can Security/Compliance produce a redacted PT summary and remediation tracker that we can share externally by Oct 14 at the latest? If there are scope or classification concerns, please flag them. I want to avoid delaying the renewal.

Laura — is it possible to share a limited redacted summary publicly and keep the raw report internal? Monica — please confirm remediation status for the critical/high items.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0132

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal gating: security assessment package request

Jonas / Monica — quick status and plan.

1) Scope: The most recent independent assessment (external red team) concluded on 2027-09-30. The raw report contains detailed exploit chains and PoCs that we must redact before external distribution. The raw report will remain internal (legal/SecOps only).

2) Redaction plan: I will produce a redacted summary that includes: executive summary, scope, high-level findings (classification: critical/high/medium/low), remediation status, and mitigations. No PoC code, IP addresses, or detailed step-by-step exploit text will be present.

3) Timeline: I can deliver the redacted assessment summary and remediation tracker by EOD 2027-10-14. In the meantime I am attaching the internal raw report for internal review only (password-protected; internal recipients only). Please do not forward.

Attachments (internal only):
- security_assessment_raw_report_2027-09-30.pdf (password protected)
- remediation_tracker_q4_2027.xlsx

If Clearwater requests an unredacted copy for their legal team under an NDA, we can evaluate but that will require a PO/Data Processing Agreement addendum and a bespoke access path.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Jonas / Laura / Maria — short remediation update from the product/ops side.

- Critical (1): mitigated 2027-10-02; verification in progress (expected closed by 2027-10-12).
- High (3): two mitigations implemented; third has a planned patch release 2027-10-18 but we have a compensating control in place and monitoring.
- Medium/Low: ongoing backlog, typical cadence.

I'll attach the latest remediation tracker extract to this thread and will update the closed-status column after final verification. Note: the tracker marks items that are safe for external reporting (status column).
